notes.title: Bug Fix (v1.1 => v1.11)
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that caused the final mission to be treated as a win, even if all the player characters were wiped out.


Found a very frivolous bug. My apologies ...
(Since it is obviously a "player advantage" bug, so I may be offended by fixing it ...)

The version under development (at the time of closed test play) was working correctly, but somehow I made a strange modification to the victory conditions, causing it to "degradation". My apologies.
